sources.title: Hakeminen tutkinto-opiskelijaksi
sources.covers: No cutoff data. Links only to Vipunen ('Alin hyväksytty pistemäärä Vipusessa', 'Korkeakoulujen pisterajat – Vipunen')

notes: Searched: WebSearch (Finnish queries for alin hyväksytty pistemäärä / pisterajat / alimmat pisteet / haun ja valinnan tilasto, incl. site: queries), the WordPress REST API of the AMK site (media library PDFs since 2023, pages and posts searched for alimmat, pisterajat, alin hyväksytty, tilastot, valintojen tulokset), the application pages and the spring 2025/2026 results news posts. Lapin AMK publishes no cutoff statistics of its own. Its application page links to Vipunen for lowest accepted scores. The media library holds no cutoff PDFs. No rows for 2024, 2025 or 2026.
